description: This file defines the NnApiDelegate class, which implements the Delegate interface for NNAPI inference in TensorFlow Lite. It includes nested classes for delegate options and interfaces for internal use, providing mechanisms to configure NNAPI execution preferences, handle errors, and manage resources.

classes.name: NnApiDelegate
classes.description: Main class implementing the NNAPI delegate for TensorFlow Lite.

classes.name: NnApiDelegate.Options
classes.description: Configurable options for the NNAPI delegate, including execution preferences, accelerator, cache directory, model token, and resource limits.

classes.name: NnApiDelegate.PrivateInterface
classes.description: Internal interface for implementing the delegate, available only within the package.

methods.name: initWithInterpreterFactoryApi(InterpreterFactoryApi interpreterFactoryApi)
methods.description: Initializes the delegate with a provided InterpreterFactoryApi instance; meant for internal TF Lite use.

methods.name: getNativeHandle()
methods.description: Returns the native handle to the delegate resources.

methods.name: close()
methods.description: Frees TensorFlow Lite delegate resources; should be called explicitly.

methods.name: getNnapiErrno()
methods.description: Retrieves the last error code from NNAPI calls since delegate creation.

methods.name: hasErrors()
methods.description: Checks if any NNAPI call failures have occurred since delegate association.
